regime: Broad relief rally: metals, miners and tech rebound together while yields climb
takeaway: Gold closed Friday up about 2.5% near $3,653 and silver about 5.3% near $43.60, and the miners jumped 7–8%, but the gold/silver ratio is still above 80, so the silver-stress check stays on. Tech led a strong shortened session (Nasdaq +2.3%) and the VIX eased to about 24, while the 2-year yield rose 8 bp, which keeps the Fed-hike check lit. Brent slipped to about $95 ahead of Sunday's OPEC+ meeting, leaving the oil check on watch.
